notice: Prototype model trained only on synthetic data. Its metrics describe the synthetic generator, not real-world fraud detection performance. Not connected to the fraud.auth UI.
target: isFraud (synthetic ground truth): probability that a pending standing-order request is fraud

dataset.source: generateDataset() default config (same as npm run data:generate)

training.classWeighting: none (probabilities stay on the training prevalence; imbalance is handled by the threshold)

candidate.rule: highest F1 on the validation set

ruleEngineTunedCutoff.label: Rule engine: score ≤ 63 (cutoff tuned for F1 on validation)

thresholds.note: Candidates for experimentation, chosen on validation data. Not a production threshold: the right value depends on the relative cost of a missed fraud versus a wrongly held legitimate payment.

tuned.label: Rule engine: score ≤ 63 (cutoff tuned on validation)

recordSplitComparison.note: Same pipeline with a record-level split. Reported for comparison; the shipped model uses the user-level split.

ablations.note: Same pipeline and split without the riskSignalCount feature. Comparison only.

tuned.label: Rule engine: score ≤ 63 (cutoff tuned on validation)

demoRequests.note: The app's three demo requests, scored for information only. Never trained on; their rule-engine scores are not targets.
